summary: Suggestions view shows 'Insufficient telemetry' for multiple routes despite sustained high QPS (telemetry lag/backfill suspected)
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer reports the Console > Optimize > Suggestions (beta) page shows the empty state: “Insufficient telemetry to generate suggestions” for a project with sustained traffic.
- Customer states QPS is consistently high and cost is material; expects at least batching/caching suggestions.

Impact:
- Customer cannot evaluate or act on Optimize Suggestions beta. Blocking their internal rollout decision for the week.

Customer-reported symptoms:
- Suggestions page shows “Insufficient telemetry” for all routes in Project: “ns-prod-assist” (org: Northstar Support).
- They can see usage/cost in other Console pages (usage analytics), which increases confusion.

Environment:
- Redwood Dedicated in us-east.
- Feature flag for suggestions beta enabled for org.

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) Impersonate org Northstar Support (per support SOP) and navigate to Console > Optimize > Suggestions.
2) Select project “ns-prod-assist”.
3) Observe empty state “Insufficient telemetry”.

Expected result:
- Suggestions list populated for at least top routes/models where request volume meets eligibility.

Actual result:
- Empty state persists across browser refresh and after 12+ hours of reported traffic.

Notes:
- Customer provided screenshot in Zendesk attachment (mirrored) showing empty state and project selector.
- Customer also noted they recently changed routing for 2 routes (renamed route IDs) around Feb 20.
comments: 2026-02-21 10:14 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Acknowledged issue to customer. Asked for: org/project IDs, approximate QPS window, top route names, and whether telemetry/tracing was recently changed. Set expectation that Suggestions uses a separate aggregate pipeline and can lag usage dashboards.

2026-02-21 11:02 PT — Miguel Santos (CS): Customer confirms: ~350–600 QPS on primary route over last 48h; new route naming convention deployed on Feb 20 18:00 PT. They see token spend in Cost/Usage pages. They’re concerned this indicates a data leak/permission issue (they can’t show Suggestions internally).

2026-02-21 11:30 PT — Nadia Rahman (Cost attribution): Taking lead. Hypothesis: suggestions eligibility relies on ‘optimize_telemetry_agg_v2’ partitions; could be lagging/backfill gap or route_id mismatch after rename. Will check pipeline lag + aggregation keys for this org/project.

2026-02-21 12:10 PT — Logan Wright (Telemetry): Checked ingestion health: raw request events present for org_id=org_3f2… in us-east. No elevated drops. However, the Optimize suggestions aggregates job appears ~19h behind for us-east shard 2. Likely stuck on a bad partition (seen once this week).

2026-02-21 12:32 PT — Nadia Rahman: Confirmed: suggestions_compute_job last successful run for Northstar project at 2026-02-20 16:00 PT. Next runs failing on ‘partition not found’ when scanning new route_id dimension values. This explains empty state: UI shows “insufficient telemetry” when no eligible aggregates exist for the last 24h window.

2026-02-21 13:05 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Updated customer: We found a delay in the Suggestions aggregation pipeline for their region/shard; raw traffic is present. ETA: we’re restarting the job and running a targeted backfill. Provided interim workaround: none for Suggestions view; usage/cost dashboards will remain correct.

2026-02-21 15:44 PT — Mei Lin (Data Eng): Root cause identified: aggregator job expected route_id in canonical format; recent route rename introduced ‘/v2/support-chat’ with a leading slash in one emitter path, causing aggregate key normalization to fail for that partition only. Fix: normalize route_id consistently before writing aggregates; backfill impacted partitions.

2026-02-22 09:18 PT — Nadia Rahman: Patch deployed to aggregator in us-east (canary → 50% → 100%). Re-ran backfill for Northstar org/project for last 72h. Compute lag now < 45 minutes. Customer should see suggestions within next recompute cycle (~1h).

2026-02-22 11:03 PT — Miguel Santos (CS): Customer confirms Suggestions list is now populated (8 suggestions). They still see a subset of routes missing; likely due to eligibility thresholds (low traffic routes) and/or new route IDs within last few hours.

2026-02-24 16:22 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Follow-up: confirmed missing routes are below minimum sample/eligibility window (insufficient stable p95 latency + cache metrics). Shared eligibility guidance and asked them to wait 24h after route rename for stable estimates.

2026-02-25 09:10 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Customer satisfied; closing ticket. Logged follow-up tasks with Telemetry/Optimize to harden partition handling and add alerting on suggestions aggregate lag per region.
investigation_notes:
What we checked:
- Verified feature flag enabled for org (beta).
- Verified RBAC not blocking (customer user has Optimize read access).
- Verified raw request telemetry exists and QPS aligns with customer claim.
- Compared UI empty state behavior: Suggestions page displays “Insufficient telemetry” when suggestion candidates table is empty for the project window (not necessarily when raw traffic is missing).

Findings:
- Optimize Suggestions aggregation/compute job in us-east shard 2 was ~19 hours behind.
- Failures were tied to route_id normalization mismatch after customer route renaming. One emitter path included a leading “/”, causing key normalization to fail and the job to skip partitions.
- Result: no eligible aggregates produced → UI shows insufficient telemetry across the project.

Customer-specific notes:
- Recent route renaming increased likelihood of hitting the normalization edge case.
- Missing routes after fix appear to be below eligibility thresholds (not a pipeline issue).
resolution:
Resolved by fixing route_id normalization in the Optimize Suggestions aggregation job and running a targeted backfill for Northstar Support (last 72h). Suggestions compute lag returned to normal (< 1h) and the Console populated suggestions for eligible routes.

Customer communication:
- Clarified that “risk” and “insufficient telemetry” relate to optimization estimation readiness, not security.
- Provided guidance: after route renames/major traffic shifts, allow ~24h to accumulate stable telemetry for p95 and cache metrics used by the estimator.

Preventative actions:
- Add alert on per-shard suggestions aggregate lag and repeated partition errors.
- Add unit/integration coverage for route_id canonicalization and emitter-path variance.
